THE PROBLEM
The snackbar and the pill run on two clocks that were never introduced. The pill hides after 3s of no touches (RAIL_IDLE_MS); a snackbar lasts 4s (SnackbarDuration.Short) and longer if the OS extends it for accessibility. Showing a message is not a touch, so the pill leaves first - and LocalNavPillInsets is a constant 112dp, so nothing closes the gap.

A is nearly free: LocalNavChromeVisible (NavPill.kt:308) already publishes pill visibility and ShortsScreen already consumes it. The work is holding the pill open while a message is up, and animating the inset instead of returning a constant.

B is not a new visual language: NoticeCard is already the app's inline banner (the 'Couldn't reach media' card), and Browse already shows a persistent one for a partial move. This makes that the general case rather than a one-off.
